First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Domestiques Tuesday and Thursday Rides group ride

A road club with weeknight rides from East Nashville and other spots around the city. Weekend rides head to quieter roads outside town. Sign-ups and start points run through the club's team app. The club says newer riders are welcome.
